paragraphs: Last updated: October 18, 2026

Pennykin is a local-first budgeting and virtual-pet app for first-time budgeters aged 14 and older. This policy explains the current app, optional support and beta feedback, and the Pennykin help website. Contact the developer at pennykinappsupport@gmail.com.

privacy.title: 1. Information stored on your device
paragraphs: The app stores your pet name and type, appearance preferences, weekly budget and category plans, expense amounts, categories, notes and Need/Want labels, reserved expenses, savings-goal progress, daily check-ins, and pet, reward and room progress in an on-device SQLite database. These records support the app's budgeting, charts and pet features.

The current app has no account registration, bank connection, advertising SDK, third-party analytics SDK or developer-operated cloud sync. Ordinary budgeting operations do not upload your transaction database to the developer. Reading the device's local date and timezone supports daily budgets and check-ins; the app does not request GPS location for this purpose.

privacy.title: 2. Optional email and beta feedback
paragraphs: If you email support, the developer receives your email address, the message and any attachments you choose to send. This information is used to respond, troubleshoot and improve Pennykin.

If you choose Share beta summary, the app prepares the beta day, number of check-in days, current streak, experience rating, answer to the one-time-price question and your optional written feedback. It does not automatically attach your expense amounts, transaction descriptions or pet name. Your own written feedback or attachments may include personal information, so avoid including private financial details.

The system share sheet lets you choose the destination or cancel. Nothing is automatically sent to the developer when you open it. The developer receives a summary only if you send it to the support address or otherwise share it with the developer. The service you choose to send it through may also process it.

privacy.title: 3. Apple testing and diagnostics
paragraphs: If you install Pennykin through TestFlight, Apple automatically collects beta usage and crash information and shares testing information with the developer. This can include app/build, device and operating-system details, sessions, crashes and diagnostic logs. Email-invited testers' names and email addresses may also be visible; public-link testers' names and email addresses are not normally shown unless supplied with feedback. Feedback and screenshots you send through TestFlight are also shared with the developer.

These platform diagnostics are separate from Pennykin's optional in-app beta summary and do not require an analytics SDK inside Pennykin. The developer uses them to investigate defects and improve the app, does not share TestFlight information with third parties, and retains downloaded diagnostic material only while needed for that purpose or applicable obligations. Apple controls retention within its own service. See Apple's TestFlight & Privacy information at https://www.apple.com/legal/privacy/data/en/test-flight/ .

For an App Store installation, Apple may separately provide diagnostics or aggregate app information under its platform settings and terms. See https://www.apple.com/legal/privacy/data/en/app-analytics/ .

privacy.title: 4. Service providers and website visits
paragraphs: Support email uses Gmail, so correspondence is also processed by Google's email service. Your email provider and any service you choose in the share sheet have their own privacy practices.

The help website is hosted through ChatGPT Sites, provided by OpenAI and its infrastructure providers. Hosting and security services may process technical information such as IP address, browser information and request logs to deliver and protect the pages. Pennykin does not add advertising pixels, a contact form or a website analytics service. The hosting service may use its own access and security mechanisms. See OpenAI's Privacy Policy at https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/ and Google's Privacy Policy at https://policies.google.com/privacy for their practices.

The developer does not sell your information, use it for advertising or tracking, or share support messages with advertisers. Information may be disclosed when required by law or necessary to address security or legal obligations.

privacy.title: 5. Retention, deletion and your choices
paragraphs: Local app records remain in the app's storage until you remove them. To reset the app, go to Insights → Settings → Delete all local data and confirm. This removes your entered records and progress from the app and returns it to initial setup. There is no server account to delete. The developer cannot view, recover, export or remotely delete records that exist only on your device.

Pennykin does not provide its own cloud sync or manual backup in this version. Device or operating-system backups, including any backup you enable, are separate. Deleting data inside the app does not delete previously created backups or messages you already sent. Manage those copies through the relevant device or service settings.

Support messages and voluntarily submitted feedback are kept only for as long as reasonably needed to respond, follow up and investigate the reported issue, or meet applicable legal or security obligations. They are deleted or de-identified when no longer needed. To request access, correction or deletion of information you sent to the developer, email pennykinappsupport@gmail.com. The developer may ask for information necessary to verify that the request concerns your own correspondence.
You can use the app without sending email or beta feedback. Cancelling or declining to share does not limit its budgeting or pet features.

privacy.title: 6. Young users
paragraphs: Pennykin is intended for users aged 14 and older. The app does not ask for a date of birth. The developer does not knowingly solicit personal information from children under 14 through support or feedback. If a parent or guardian believes a child has sent personal information to the developer, contact pennykinappsupport@gmail.com so the correspondence can be reviewed and deleted where appropriate.

privacy.title: 7. Money and purchases
paragraphs: Pennykin does not connect to financial institutions, move real money or provide financial advice. Pet Coins and care resources are fictional and have no cash value. The current version has no active in-app purchase or subscription. A future feature that changes data handling will be reflected in an updated policy before it is introduced.

privacy.title: 8. Changes and contact
paragraphs: The date above identifies the latest policy update. Material changes to how the app handles information will be reflected here and, when appropriate, communicated in the app.

For privacy questions, support or requests concerning correspondence you sent, contact pennykinappsupport@gmail.com. Do not send passwords, verification codes, bank details or unredacted screenshots of financial records.
A gentle first budget, with a tiny companion.

support.title: Contact Pennykin
paragraphs: Email: pennykinappsupport@gmail.com

For a bug report, include the Pennykin version shown in Settings, your device model, iOS or Android version, what you expected and the steps that caused the problem. Screenshots are optional: remove expense amounts, notes, names and other private details first. Never send passwords, verification codes or bank details.
This is an independently supported app. Replies are handled by the developer; no fixed response time is promised.

support.title: Where is my financial information stored?
paragraphs: Your records and pet progress are stored on your device. The current app has no login, bank connection or developer-operated cloud sync. The developer cannot recover records that exist only on your device. Operating-system backups are separate from Pennykin's features.

support.title: How do daily check-ins work?
paragraphs: Record an expense, or use I spent $0 today when you have no expenses that day. Either can earn the daily check-in reward. Three new expense entries in the same local calendar day earn the separate mystery gift. The amount spent does not increase the reward; do not spend money or invent entries to earn gifts.

support.title: How is Safe to Spend calculated?
paragraphs: The app subtracts this week's recorded spending and reserved future expenses from your weekly budget, then divides the nonnegative flexible balance across the remaining calendar days, including today. It is an estimate based on what you entered, not a bank balance or financial advice. Weeks begin on Monday. Today and check-ins follow your device's local date and timezone; existing transaction dates are preserved if your timezone changes.

support.title: How do I change my pet or budget?
paragraphs: Open Insights → Settings → Profile & privacy → Edit for your pet and weekly budget. Use the Budget Planner in Insights to change category allocations and manage reserved expenses. Savings-goal controls are also in Insights.

support.title: How do I delete my data?
paragraphs: Go to Insights → Settings → Delete all local data, then confirm. Your entered records and progress are removed from the app and it returns to setup. The developer cannot undo this reset. It does not remove device backups or feedback/email copies already shared. For deletion of correspondence sent to the developer, email the support address.

support.title: How do I send beta feedback?
paragraphs: Go to Insights → Settings → Beta feedback. Review the summary and choose Share beta summary. You decide where it goes and can cancel. To send it to the developer, select your email app and address it to pennykinappsupport@gmail.com. Its automatic fields exclude transaction amounts and descriptions; avoid adding private information in your written notes.

support.title: Does TestFlight share testing information?
paragraphs: Yes. Apple automatically provides TestFlight usage and crash information to the developer, separately from the in-app Share beta summary feature. TestFlight may also provide tester contact information depending on the invitation method. See the Privacy Policy for details, and avoid including private financial information in screenshots or feedback.

support.title: I cannot open a webpage or email app
paragraphs: The Privacy Policy is also readable inside Pennykin without a connection. To use online support, reconnect and try again. If an email app is unavailable, use Copy support email and paste the address into your preferred email service.

support.title: Is Founders Pro available?
paragraphs: There is no active subscription or in-app purchase in this version. Any Founders Pro description is a future plan. Pet Coins are fictional resources and are not real money.

support.title: Privacy
paragraphs: Read the Privacy Policy for local storage, optional feedback, service providers, retention and deletion choices. Contact pennykinappsupport@gmail.com with privacy questions.
